property_summary: For any caller funded with any balance and when the contract owner calls withdrawAll(recipient) after funding the contract, the reference C transfers the entire contract balance to the recipient (leaving c.balance == 0); the mutant that sends only half the balance violates this by leaving c.balance > 0 for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace transfer of the full balance with transfer of half the balance (integer division), changing the amount withdrawn.
